svg.aria-label: Selected work: OpenHealth: Private medical assistant: QLoRA-fine-tuned Llama 3 8B, hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval over clinical guidelines with citations, five services on Docker Compose. Measured: retrieval about 0.1 s warm, 4.2 s per answer on a T4. asme-rag-harness: Clause-level retrieval evaluation over an engineering code, with abstention and a citation graph. Network-Security-Pipeline: MLOps pipeline for phishing-site detection: schema and drift checks, MLflow tracking, a FastAPI service, Docker image shipped to AWS by CI. Person-Reidentification-System: Cross-camera person re-identification API on torchreid embeddings, served with Flask. Unattended-Baggage-Detection: Flags unattended bags in video by tracking people and bags with YOLOv8 and Deep SORT. Kubernetes-Store-Provisioning-Platform: A Kubernetes operator that provisions isolated store environments: Helm, network policies, resource quotas.
